name: finance.revenue.forecast
description: Generate revenue forecasts using historical enrollment data, subscription MRR, and growth projections. Feeds the pitch deck financial projections.

steps.name: Get current MRR from subscriptions
steps.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit), 0) as mtd_revenue FROM fin_journal_lines jl JOIN fin_journal_entries je ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id AND je.is_posted = true WHERE jl.account_number IN ('4010', '4020', '4030') AND je.entry_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

steps.name: Get enrollment counts
steps.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'patient' AND status = 'active') as active_patients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'provider' AND status = 'active') as active_providers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') as new_signups_30d

steps.name: Get burn rate
steps.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit), 0) as monthly_expenses FROM fin_journal_lines jl JOIN fin_journal_entries je ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id AND je.is_posted = true WHERE (jl.account_number LIKE '5%' OR jl.account_number LIKE '6%') AND je.entry_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
